faqs.question: How can I manage my monthly subscriptions efficiently?
faqs.answer: SubFlow brings your subscriptions into one interface so you can track recurring expenses, view due dates, and keep a clear picture of your budget.

faqs.question: How do I track subscription spending over time?
faqs.answer: The app helps you visualize monthly spending trends, analyze categories, and understand how recurring costs affect your budget.

faqs.question: Is SubFlow a free app?
faqs.answer: Yes, SubFlow offers a free experience, with advanced features available through SubFlow+ for deeper analysis and optimization.

faqs.question: Which devices support SubFlow?
faqs.answer: SubFlow is available on iPhone, iPad, and Android, with an experience designed for simple everyday subscription management.

faqs.question: How does SubFlow help me save money on subscriptions?
faqs.answer: SubFlow detects unused services, duplicates, and price increases so you can cut unnecessary recurring spending.

faqs.question: How do I know how much I spend on subscriptions each month?
faqs.answer: Add your subscriptions to SubFlow: the app totals your recurring spending and groups it by category, so you can see exactly where your money goes every month.

faqs.question: Does SubFlow remind me before a charge?
faqs.answer: Yes. SubFlow alerts you before each due date so you avoid surprise charges and have time to cancel a subscription you no longer need.

faqs.question: Is my data safe with SubFlow?
faqs.answer: Your information stays stored locally on your device. No data is shared with third parties.

guide.title: What is subscription tracking?
guide.definition: Subscription tracking means listing every recurring expense (streaming, music, phone plan, gym, insurance, software) so you know how much each one costs per month, when it is charged, and whether you still use it. SubFlow is a free app for iPhone, iPad and Android that brings this tracking together and alerts you before every charge.
guide.stepsTitle: How to track your subscriptions in 3 steps

steps.title: List your subscriptions
steps.description: Add each subscription to SubFlow with its price, billing frequency and charge date. Netflix, Spotify, Disney+ or your phone plan: it takes seconds.

steps.title: See your budget
steps.description: The calendar and charts show your total recurring spending, its breakdown by category, and your upcoming charges.

steps.title: Cut what you don't use
steps.description: Spot unused subscriptions, duplicates and price increases, then cancel the ones you no longer need.
